summary: Vendor deposit follow-up (narrow slice): due date, event date and agreed total (with basis) on vendor_deposits; an append-only reconciliation ledger (proposals, decisions, events); three audited SECURITY DEFINER functions; and a CHANGE to grants on the existing vendor_deposits table (UPDATE becomes column-level so only the new follow-up columns are function-only). Never pays or changes an AP amount, a journal entry or a deposit's status. Creates no data.

preflight.name: reconciliation table does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendor_deposit_reconciliations'

preflight.name: vendor_deposits exists (migration 364)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendor_deposits'

preflight.name: follow-up columns not added yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'vendor_deposits' AND column_name IN ('balance_due_date', 'agreed_total_cents')

preflight.name: journal_entries has status and community_id (manual-accounting check)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'journal_entries' AND column_name IN ('status', 'community_id')

expected_changes: Adds follow-up columns to vendor_deposits: event_date, balance_due_date (+ basis), agreed_total_cents (+ required basis; an estimate unless quote/contract), project_id. Existing rows keep NULLs; no row changes.
Creates empty append-only tables vendor_deposit_reconciliations, vendor_deposit_reconciliation_decisions and vendor_deposit_events.

Creates vendor_deposit_set_followup, vendor_deposit_propose and vendor_deposit_decide (SECURITY DEFINER, EXECUTE for service_role only). Each writes its change and audit event in one transaction with row locks. manual_accounting_recorded is an admin attestation with structural checks (net > 0, bill total = net, deposit paid unchanged, one applied bill per deposit, and a posted relief JE crediting the deposit account for the deposit amount when the deposit was booked prepaid; none when it was expensed).

CHANGES grants on the EXISTING table vendor_deposits (not visible in the object diff, so verified below): table-level UPDATE is revoked from service_role/authenticated/anon and re-granted to service_role on every pre-existing column. Only the six new follow-up columns are function-only. DELETE, INSERT and SELECT are unchanged.

verify.name: the three audited functions exist
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname IN ('vendor_deposit_set_followup', 'vendor_deposit_propose', 'vendor_deposit_decide')

verify.name: one terminal decision per reconciliation, one decision per relief JE
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname IN ('uq_vdrd_one_terminal', 'uq_vdrd_je_used_once')

grant change: follow-up column balance_due_date is function-only
